name: task-list
description: Opt-in persistent task checklist: the agent asks to use it, the user approves, checks items off and alone can clear or disable it.

paneWidth.title: Pane width
paneWidth.description: Columns the task pane asks for when docked beside the transcript. 0 leaves the width to Claude Code; a width you drag the pane to wins.

maxCompleted.title: Completed tasks shown
maxCompleted.description: How many of the most recently completed tasks the pane lists under the open ones. 0 hides completed tasks.
